analyst.summary: Blue Star: Q4 FY26/Q1 FY27 headline prints beat, but FY26 full-year consolidated PAT fell 10.8% YoY (partly one-off provision noise) and room-AC (Unitary) revenue fell 5.1% for the year - a price/margin-led optic, not clean volume growth. Competitive intensity is rising (Daikin capex, Voltas share push) while Blue Star's own share-gain target is the mildest of the top-4, and the stock trades at PE ~66-90x / PB ~10x against management's own 2030 margin-pressure guidance. No quant score yet -> Hold by default; escalation flagged on valuation/quality-of-earnings risk.
